description:
Preview publication or revocation of a saved MCP diagnostic snapshot.
    Requires the private management key returned by diagnose_mcp(save_report=true).
    No action unless confirm=true. Publication exposes only the redacted stored snapshot
    until seven-day expiry. Public copies cannot be recalled; no target ownership or safety claim.
    Never put the management key in URLs, public reports or messages.
name: publish_mcp_report
